news.content: FED’S BARR SIGNALS MORE RATE HIKES AHEADFed Governor Michael Barr says further rate hikes will likely be needed to bring inflation back to target after last week’s 25bp increase.Barr said the Fed had been “out of position” before the latest hike.The Fed’s dot plot reinforces the hawkish message: 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike in 2026, with four projecting two.

news.title: U.S. PMI SURGES, SIGNALING STRONG GROWTH AND RISING COST PRESSURESU.S. business activity accelerated sharply in September, with manufacturing PMI rising to 57.0
news.content: U.S. PMI SURGES, SIGNALING STRONG GROWTH AND RISING COST PRESSURESU.S. business activity accelerated sharply in September, with manufacturing PMI rising to 57.0, services to 58.7, and the composite index to 58.4, all well above expectations.The data points to the strongest growth in more than five years, supported by robust hiring and demand.However, input costs jumped to their highest level since 2022, driven by higher energy and transport costs, adding to inflation concerns even as selling-price increases remained relatively contained.

news.title: Donald Trump wants the U.S. to beat China in the AI race. But as he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping, both countries are also weighing how to address the risk
news.content: Donald Trump wants the U.S. to beat China in the AI race. But as he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping, both countries are also weighing how to address the risks posed by rapidly advancing technology.In recent months, AI systems have taken more consequential actions online: OpenAI said one of its research models gained unauthorized access to parts of the AI platform Hugging Face, while Anthropic found AI was being used to automate parts of cyberattacks. The incidents have raised fears that increasingly autonomous models could make attacks faster and harder to contain.

news.content: Para menteri energi aliansi OPEC+ mengonfirmasi perpanjangan pembatasan suplai sukarela sebesar 1.65 juta barel per hari hingga kuartal mendatang. Lonjakan harga minyak WTI dan Brent langsung mendongkrak Dolar Kanada (CAD) dan menekan mata uang importir energi.

event_sources.original_title: GOLD | Stronger Dollar & Profit-Taking Pressure Gold as Middle East Risks Persist⏰ Gold is starting the week under moderate selling pressure after last week’s s
event_sources.original_content: GOLD | Stronger Dollar & Profit-Taking Pressure Gold as Middle East Risks Persist⏰ Gold is starting the week under moderate selling pressure after last week’s strong recovery, with a firmer U.S. dollar and profit-taking weighing on the metal.🟠 The macro backdrop remains challenging. The Federal Reserve’s latest rate hike and expectations for additional tightening continue to support U.S. rates and the dollar. Current market pricing also shows meaningful expectations for another Fed move, although the exact probability varies by meeting and changes intraday, Reuters reports roughly a 55% probability of another hike in October in Monday’s pricing.🟠 At the same time, oil prices are falling again, with Brent down around 2% on Monday amid hopes for diplomatic progress and improving Saudi supply flows. That is important for gold because lower crude reduces some of the longer-term inflation pressure and can ease expectations for aggressive monetary tightening.🟠 Middle East tensions add another layer. ⚠️ Escalation can generate safe-haven demand for gold, but if it causes another sustained surge in oil, the inflationary consequences could push yields and rate expectations higher—eventually becoming a headwind for gold.⚠️ The important distinction is therefore between short-term geopolitical safe-haven buying and the longer-term inflation/rates effect of the conflict.🕯 SM Market Outlook: Short-term neutral-to-bearish while the dollar remains firm and profit-taking continues. Lower oil is limiting the downside, while renewed geopolitical escalation could quickly increase volatility and safe-haven demand.
